description: This file defines a configuration class for an OpenAI-like chat completion transformation, including methods for handling API parameters, response processing, and message format conversions tailored to a specific provider implementation.

classes.name: OpenAILikeChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class extending OpenAIGPTConfig, providing custom methods for provider info, response transformation, and parameter mapping.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns API base URL and API key suitable for an OpenAI-like provider, possibly from secret managers.

methods.name: ChatCompletionAssistantMessage _json_mode_convert_tool_response_to_message( message: ChatCompletionAssistantMessage, json_mode: bool )
methods.description: Converts tool call responses to message content in JSON mode by extracting 'arguments' from the tool call.

methods.name: dict _sanitize_usage_obj(response_json: dict)
methods.description: Ensures 'usage' objects in responses have numeric token counts, replacing nulls with zeros for compatibility.

methods.name: ModelResponse _transform_response( model: str, response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, stream: bool, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, optional_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str], data: Union[dict, str], messages: List, print_verbose, encoding, json_mode: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], base_model: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response, sanitizes data, and converts messages if in JSON mode, returning a structured model response.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Public wrapper for _transform_response, providing a simplified interface.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, replace_max_completion_tokens_with_max_tokens: bool = True, )
methods.description: Maps parameters to be compatible with OpenAI, replacing 'max_completion_tokens' with 'max_tokens' if applicable.
